start.title: [TODO:ar] Sons of the Soil
start.text:
[TODO:ar] You are Cain, firstborn of Adam.
Your brother Abel walks beside you in the dawn.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Genesis 4:1-2 — Cain and Abel were the first two brothers, sons of Adam and Eve.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Compare yourself to him in silence
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] A quiet bitterness takes root.
[TODO:ar] He calls your name. You do not turn.

fields.title: [TODO:ar] The Tiller of Soil
fields.text:
[TODO:ar] The earth resists your hoe.
Sweat. Stones. The long hours of work.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Genesis 4:2 — Cain worked the soil while Abel kept flocks.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Curse the ground as you dig
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Each strike grows angrier than the last.

abel_pasture.title: [TODO:ar] Your Brother's Flock
abel_pasture.text:
[TODO:ar] Abel rests among his sheep, content.
A newborn lamb sleeps on his chest.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Be glad for his gentle work
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Warmth rises where envy could have grown.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Resent that his work seems easy
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Genesis 4:5 — Cain grew envious and downcast when God favored Abel.
[TODO:ar] Your words stay quiet, but they sting your own soul.

offerings.title: [TODO:ar] Before the Altar
offerings.text:
[TODO:ar] It is time to bring an offering to the Lord.
What will you give?

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You choose the finest grain. Your heart is open.
[TODO:ar] Genesis 4:3 — Cain brought some of the fruits of the soil, not his very best.
[TODO:ar] Empty hands. A harder, prouder heart.

accepted.title: [TODO:ar] The Lord's Favor
accepted.text:
[TODO:ar] The Lord receives Abel's lamb with joy.
Your offering — He does not regard.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You ask why. The answer is already in you.
[TODO:ar] Genesis 4:5 — Cain became very angry when his offering was not accepted.
[TODO:ar] Your fist rises. The sky does not answer.

anger.title: [TODO:ar] Why Are You Angry?
anger.text:
[TODO:ar] Your face falls. Your hands shake.
The Lord asks: "Why are you angry?"

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Lay your anger down before Him
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The fire begins to cool. Honesty opens a path.
[TODO:ar] Genesis 4:5-6 — Cain turned his face away and refused to answer God.

warning.title: [TODO:ar] Sin Crouches at the Door
warning.text:
[TODO:ar] "Sin is crouching at your door.
Its desire is for you — but you must master it."

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You exhale. You will choose differently.
[TODO:ar] Genesis 4:7 — Cain did not master the sin crouching at his door.
[TODO:ar] The warning fades. The hatred remains.

invitation.title: [TODO:ar] Come With Me to the Field
invitation.text:
[TODO:ar] Abel walks toward you, trusting.
His face is open. Yours is not.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Tell him the truth of your heart
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Words are hard. But honesty is mercy.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Lure him alone into the field
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Genesis 4:8 — Cain lured Abel out into the field.

field.title: [TODO:ar] In the Field
field.text:
[TODO:ar] The field is empty. No one will see.
Anger surges. A stone is in your hand.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] It falls heavy at your feet. You breathe again.
[TODO:ar] Genesis 4:8 — Cain rose up against Abel his brother and killed him.
[TODO:ar] Your hand obeys the rage. The field receives him.

confrontation.title: [TODO:ar] "Where Is Your Brother?"
confrontation.text:
[TODO:ar] The voice of the Lord finds you.
"Where is your brother Abel?"

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Confess what your hands have done
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The truth crushes you. And begins to free you.
[TODO:ar] Genesis 4:9 — Cain replied, 'Am I my brother's keeper?'

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Stay silent and hide your eyes
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] His blood cries out from the ground.

wanderer.title: [TODO:ar] East of Eden, Marked
wanderer.text:
[TODO:ar] The Lord places a mark to protect you.
You must wander far from home.
